scope: Exact historical alpha.10 mashup replay through current ProjectStore open and authoring UI; reviewed foundation-only v1 migration, provenance, source/result tamper refusals, current recipe replay, Apply/Undo/Redo/save-reopen, and shared movement recipe migration. Mock DOM; no browser or hardware acceptance.

results.name: Versioned foundation-only contract is bounded and raw alpha.10 source/result hashes remain unchanged
Every shipped alpha.10 recipe opens through current actual handlers, reissues and preserves original bytes
Reopened donors also migrate with all exact source identities and result equivalence checked
Any non-foundation base or donor alteration is refused without weakening exact-source checks
Tampered historical recipe hashes, bytes, bindings, choices and gameplay decisions are rejected
Foundation values outside the reviewed release set are not guessed or stripped
A verified legacy base cannot be silently swapped with a loaded donor
Movement v1 metadata migration shares the contract, preserves locks and uses current UI Apply/Undo
Failed historical import retains the established preview and original project/history
